Contractual Payment Terms

Payment is due in full to Storm Shield Pro Roofing & Construction in Houston, Texas immediately upon completion of the work. For projects extending beyond thirty (30) days on site, progress billing for materials delivered and work completed is due and payable on the tenth (10th) day of each calendar month following performance. Customer obligations remain absolute regardless of invoice receipt.
Delinquency & Collection Costs

Payments not received within five (5) calendar days of the due date are deemed in default and shall bear interest from the due date at the lesser of 15% per annum or the maximum legal rate. Customer agrees to pay all collection costs, including reasonable attorney fees and filing fees, incurred to recover delinquent balances.
Structural Workspace Hazard Notice

Roofing work involves heavy construction, tearing, and demolition, creating risks of falling debris. Customer agrees to keep guests, invitees, and occupants clear of the active work area. Storm Shield Pro is not liable for injuries to anyone entering the construction zone.
Internal Structural Dust & Attic Management

Roofing replacement generates significant vibrations and dust. Airborne particles and small debris will enter the attic space. Customer should use extreme caution when lowering attic stairs post-construction to prevent falling debris from causing facial or eye injuries.
Exterior Landscaping Protections

While crews utilize protective tarps and property safeguards, minor accidental impact to vegetation, shrubbery, or lawns may occur during tear-off. Storm Shield Pro is not responsible for minor landscaping or plant damage resulting from standard construction operations.
Driveway Structural Clearance

Customer must provide clear, unobstructed driveway access for material delivery trucks and equipment. The machinery and bundles required are extremely heavy. Storm Shield Pro is not responsible for driveway, curb, or sidewalk damage resulting from natural settling, compression, or inadequate sub-slab structural support.
Hidden Rafter Flaws & Deflection

Stripping existing roof layers frequently exposes pre-existing structural issues. Correcting structural defects, sagging framing, or warped trusses is excluded from this scope unless explicitly added. New shingles may accentuate pre-existing deck deflections, for which Storm Shield Pro bears no responsibility.
Utility Routing Under Sheathing

Standard building codes require mechanical lines, HVAC conduits, water pipes, and electrical lines to be secured a safe distance below the roof deck. Storm Shield Pro is not responsible for accidental punctures caused by fasteners striking lines improperly run flush against the underside of the wood sheathing.
Shingle Surface Settlement & Thermal Variables

Fiberglass and asphalt shingles installed during cooler temperatures require solar heat exposure to activate the thermal sealing strips. Heavier architectural or triple-lam shingles may not lay completely flat immediately. This is a natural material characteristic and does not constitute an installation defect.
Wall Flashing & Exterior Siding Disruption

Proper shingle installation requires integrating flashing with existing wall siding. Brittle, weathered, or aging siding immediately adjacent to flashing zones may crack, chip, or tear during detachment and re-roofing. Storm Shield Pro is not responsible for repairing or replacing such pre-existing fragile siding components.
Vibration Impact on Internal Ceilings & Finishes

Roof demolition transmits significant vibrations throughout the building framework. Customer is strictly required to remove all mirrors, pictures, artifacts, loose light fixtures, and chandeliers from interior walls and ceilings prior to commencement. Storm Shield Pro is not liable for damage to items falling inside or outside the property.
Mechanical Satellites & Rooftop Electronics

It may be operationally necessary to temporarily detach satellite dishes, solar devices, or antennas. Customer is responsible for scheduling and paying for recalibration or realignment. Storm Shield Pro may remove these items to facilitate the installation but holds no obligation to re-align or restore electronic signals.
High Voltage Electrical Accessories

Installation crews are not licensed electrical technicians. Customer must retain a qualified electrician to safely disconnect, reconnect, or wire powered ventilation fans or rooftop electrical systems if required during the roofing process.
Unforeseen Substrate Code Supplements

If building code inspectors require unexpected field modifications during construction (including extensive rotted deck replacement, supplemental insulation, or corrected ventilation), customer authorizes Storm Shield Pro to supplement the insurance carrier for additional funds. These supplemental payments are fully payable directly to Storm Shield Pro.
Exclusive Remedy & Workmanship Standards

We warrant that our installers will perform their work in a good, workmanlike manner and that the roof area handled will remain free from leaks caused by workmanship defects for the period specified. Our liability is strictly limited to providing labor to repair the specific leaked area, which constitutes the sole remedy available under this contract. This labor warranty is transferable to a new owner for up to one year from property transfer or until original expiration, whichever occurs first.
Manufacturer Product Warranties

All material product warranties are issued directly by the shingle manufacturer. Storm Shield Pro will transfer all product warranties to the customer upon receipt of final contract payment in full. Customer is responsible for submitting any registration cards.
Water Intrusion Assessment Deadlines

Customer must notify Storm Shield Pro within seventy-two (72) hours of discovering any roof leak and take immediate reasonable actions to mitigate interior damage. Customer agrees to grant safe access to interior and exterior areas at reasonable times to conduct required multi-stage inspections.
Environmental Mold & Hazard Mitigation Exclusion

Customer explicitly releases Storm Shield Pro Roofing & Construction from any liability, claims, or damages regarding environmental hazards or toxic conditions, including the growth, presence, or mitigation of mold, mildew, or airborne spores resulting from moisture or water entry, regardless of alleged negligence.
Casualty Loss & Insurance Maintenance

Storm Shield Pro is not responsible for damage caused by fire, windstorms, hail, tornadoes, hurricanes, lightning, or acts of God to work in progress or completed systems. Customer must maintain standard homeowner casualty insurance in full force. There are no other warranties, express or implied, including merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose, applicable to this contract.
Binding Arbitration Agreement

Any dispute, claim, or controversy arising out of or relating to the performance of services or materials under this contract shall be settled exclusively via binding arbitration conducted in accordance with the Commercial Arbitration Rules of the American Arbitration Association (AAA). Judgment on the award may be entered in any court of competent jurisdiction in Harris County, Texas, or the county where the work was performed.
Fully Integrated Execution Covenant

This two-page contract represents the complete agreement between both parties and supersedes all prior written or oral representations. Any modifications must be executed in writing by both parties. This contract is governed by and construed under the laws of the State of Texas. If any provision is deemed unenforceable, remaining terms remain in full force.
